purpose: Dedicated editor workspace for configuring member-local geometry of a SpeakerSet before returning to the main acoustic visualizer
capabilities: edit local yaw/pitch/roll or equivalent orientation
flow: open a SpeakerSet from the main visualizer
edit the set in local coordinates
return to the main visualizer where the complete set is manipulated through its parent transform
rules: the editor changes SpeakerSet structure and member-local transforms; it is not a separate acoustic model
the main visualizer may treat a set as one manipulation target while acoustic calculation still evaluates its individual Speaker members
editing a member inside the set editor must not destroy its model reference or signal-chain identity
type-specific helpers are optional conveniences layered on the generic set editor
